label_concern_check.verdict: Expression does not predict which organs a label warns about. Controlling for payload mechanism does not rescue it. This agrees with PMID 38692647, which found ADC toxicity largely antigen-independent with target tissue expression poorly correlated with dose-limiting toxicity. So expression may locate the organ a target could reach -- see the on-target check -- but must not reject a candidate or set a rate.

axes_not_evaluable.constitutional: systemic, not an organ; no tissue in either source

pairs.mechanism: enfortumab vedotin skin toxicity; NECTIN4 is in normal skin

known_on_target_check.note: Five pairs but four independent facts: the three blood targets are one fact about immune antigens in immune tissue. Hand-picked with stated mechanisms, written before the numbers were read, and not a systematic sample.
